description: This source file defines the API endpoint class 'ValidateProjectNameAPI' for validating the uniqueness of project names within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It handles HTTP GET requests, processes query parameters such as project name, project ID, and customer ID, and returns whether the project name can be changed (i.e., if it is available). It uses traits and classes for validation, request handling, and data retrieval.

classes.name: ValidateProjectNameAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of project names, handling GET requests to check if a project name is available for use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles the GET request to validate if the project name is available. Retrieves parameters, checks project existence if project ID is provided, and returns a boolean indicating if the project name can be changed.
